summary: Completed e2e testing of Iteration 18 features: Multiplayer Chat (WebSocket-based with 4 channels) and Skill Trees (5 trees with 32 skills, 10 title passives). All 27 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend UI verified with all chat components working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Registration endpoint properly includes display_name field with .copy() to avoid _id mutation
Multiplayer Chat WebSocket at /api/chat/ws/{user_id} properly handles connection, presence, and message routing
Chat REST APIs properly exclude MongoDB _id from responses
Skill Trees API returns 5 trees (combat, magic, crafting, social, survival) with 32 total skills
Title Passives API returns 10 titles with proper passive bonuses (e.g., Explorer: +5% movement speed, +20% exploration XP)
Party system supports create, join, leave, and info retrieval
Block system allows blocking/unblocking users for whisper filtering
seed_data_creation: Created test user with display_name for registration testing
